mods.name: Adventure Backpacks
mods.description: Craftable, upgradeable, and wearable backpacks with dedicated inventory slots, weight reduction, and biome protection effects.

mods.name: Balrond Dual Mastery
mods.description: Adds dual-wielding weapon mechanics, custom combat animations, and a new Dual Wielding skill progression.

mods.name: Build On Ship
mods.description: Enables placing chests, crafting tables, lights, and custom pieces directly onto ships and carts.

mods.name: Conditional Config Sync
mods.description: Server-to-client configuration synchronization engine enforcing consistent gameplay rules across players.

mods.name: Valheim Configuration Manager
mods.description: In-game settings menu. Press F1 in-game to tweak client settings, keybinds, and visual mod options live.

mods.name: Craft From Chests
mods.description: Craft, build, and repair items directly using ingredients stored in nearby chests within range.

mods.name: Crop Utils
mods.description: Grid planting and bulk harvest helpers for farming carrots, turnips, onions, and barley smoothly.

mods.name: Easy Relocate
mods.description: Pick up, move, and rotate pre-built furniture, chests, and structures without deconstructing them.

mods.name: Extra Slots
mods.description: Dedicated equipment slots for armor, cape, utility items, and quick-access potion slots.

mods.name: HUD Compass
mods.description: Subtle top compass bar showing cardinal directions, map pins, carts, beds, and custom waypoints.

mods.name: Jötunn, the Valheim Library
mods.description: Foundational modding framework providing custom item, piece, localization, and network sync APIs.

mods.name: PlanBuild
mods.description: Blueprint creation, transparent planning pieces, terrain tools, and collaborative multi-player base construction.

mods.name: Quick Stack, Store, Sort, Trash, Restock
mods.description: 1-key stacking of matching inventory items into nearby chests, container sorting, item favoriting, and quick restock.

mods.name: XPortal
mods.description: Select any portal destination from an interactive map list without needing matching pair tags.
